scenes.narration: Scaled dot-product attention starts with the query-key inner product. We divide by root dimension to keep logits calm, apply softmax normalization, and gather the weighted value vectors.

visual.heading: Scaled Dot-Product Attention

terms.label: Query-key product
terms.gloss: Scores pairwise similarity between every query token and key token.

terms.label: Root dimension
terms.gloss: Stabilizes softmax variance before large vector widths saturate.

terms.label: Softmax normalization
terms.gloss: Turns similarity logits into non-negative weights summing to one.

terms.label: Weighted value
terms.gloss: Blends value representations proportional to those attention weights.

visual.caption: Terms highlight in narration order alongside plain-English definitions.

scenes.narration: Bayes rule updates a prior belief with incoming likelihood evidence, then rescales by total evidence so posterior beliefs still sum to one.

visual.heading: Posterior Updating with Bayes Rule

terms.label: Prior belief
terms.gloss: Baseline plausibility assigned to hypothesis H before observing evidence.

terms.label: Likelihood evidence
terms.gloss: How expected the observed data E would be if H were true.

terms.label: Total evidence
terms.gloss: Normalizing probability of E across every competing hypothesis.

visual.caption: Both equations share the tagged total evidence term cleanly.
